purpose: Editorial source map: broad outlet-neutral discovery, claim-specific original-record verification

discovery.policy: Open to all publishers. Named outlets are discovery starting points, not an inclusion whitelist or credibility ranking.

requirements: Competent authority is selected by the specific claim, not source reputation.
Check legal action, operative effect, current court orders, dates and supersession where relevant.
Check cited passages and data rather than assuming a homepage or link verifies an assertion.
Disclose unreachable sources and missing coverage; do not fabricate verification.
This file is a research configuration reference, not proof that all domains are programmatically integrated.
